economic_hypothesis: A prior-session PIT bull market and broad positive industry create demand context. A stock with a low-turnover bounded platform that opens through its nearby inventory ceiling is only a quote change at 09:30.  It becomes a tradable information-repricing event only when completed 09:31-10:00 bars show persistent acceptance above the old close, actual traversal of the ceiling, and non-trivial early turnover.
failure: information-gap failure: completed signal-day or later daily coordinate close below prior coordinate close; after T+1, exit at next legal daily open

forward.final_gate: 2014-2023 capacity accepted completed/year>50, mean net>5%, mean hold<15, every 2021-2023 annual mean positive, at least 8/10 annual means positive, and no dominant signal date

independence: No collapse, downward-gap, gap-repair, V6/V7/V26 identity or outcome is used.
opening_information_gap: 09:30 minute open is +1% to +7% versus prior raw close and no more than 5% below the frozen prior20 coordinate high; open is below the known upper price limit

prior_only_conditions.HEALTHY_INDUSTRY: prior PIT industry n20>=5, median ret20>0, positive-ret20 share>50%
prior_only_conditions.QUIET_NEAR_PLATFORM: prior20 return [-8%,+12%], prior20 range<=25%, prior60 range<=40%, no prior20 limit-up close, prior5 mean amount/prior20 mean amount<=1, and prior close >=90% of prior20 coordinate high

target: coordinate target from exact 10:01 entry; first target realization is T+1

ten_oclock_features.acceptance_prev: share of 30 completed closes >= prior raw close
ten_oclock_features.early_amount_share: 09:30-10:00 amount / mean amount of prior20 completed stock sessions
ten_oclock_features.entry: exact next 1m bar open at 10:01; positive bar volume and below upper limit
ten_oclock_features.platform_traversed: 10:00 close in QD-010 coordinate >= frozen prior20 high
